com.esignal.jstandard.managers

Interface ResourceManager

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    AnalyticsManager, AuthenticationManager, ContentManager, HistoryManager, MarketDepthManager, NewsManager, ProxyManager, QuoteManager, TickHistoryManager, TriggeredQuoteEventManager
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractResourceManager

    public interface ResourceManager
    This is the base interface of any ResourceManager. The interface provides methods to connect and disconnect to appropriate resource. It also provides a method to check back on the status of the resource. The users/clients should always call connect method before using any resource manager. Also, the users/clients should do the same for disconnect while closing the application. The data should not be provided back to the user if they are not connected to the appropriate resource.
    Since:
    01-001-0007
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

    • Method Detail

      • connect

        void connect(ConnectionSettings connectionSettings,
             ConnectionListener connectionListener)
      throws ResourceManagerException
        This method creates an appropriate connection and attaches that to a listener. This method uses the ConnectionListener to notify the state of the connection as well as any exception thrown while connecting to the Resource. All applications using any type of ResourceManager should call this method before calling any other method on the manager.
        Parameters:
        connectionSettings - ConnectionSettings to be used for this manager
        connectionListener - ConnectionListener to listen to for this manager
        Throws:
        ResourceManagerException - Exception during establishing a connection

      • disconnect

        void disconnect()
         throws ResourceManagerException
        This method closes the connection properly. This method uses the same ConnectionListener to notify the client that was given while connecting. All applications using any type of ResourceManager should call this method before closing/ending the application. Also, any connection related exceptions (ConnectionException) can be retrieved via ConnectionListener.
        Throws:
        ResourceManagerException - If could not close connections properly.

      • getStatus

        ResourceStatus getStatus()
        The method returns the status of this ResourceManager e.g. What's going on with Connection
        Returns:
        ResourceStatus value
